test_module_id_stripping_builtin: test that module and source IDs are stripped in the shipped cbench-v1/crc32 LLVM benchmark
test_module_id_stripping_custom: test that module and source IDs are stripped in a custom C benchmark compiled via env.make_benchmark
run_llvm_env_reset: run env.reset with a benchmark name to load an LLVM benchmark and access its IR via env.ir
run_llvm_env_make_benchmark: run env.make_benchmark on a C source file to create a custom LLVM benchmark for testing
test_llvm_ir_moduleid_assertion: test that the LLVM IR output contains ModuleID and source_filename set to stripped placeholder values
